title: URL Shortener
summary: A single-region URL shortener with a deliberately disconnected redirect cache, used to exercise validator issues in the local API screenshots. The design has no blocking flag.

requirements.text: Users can create a short link from a long URL.
Redirects must complete in under 50 ms at p95.
The system must run in a single region.

components.name: Web Client
components.description: Browser application where users create short links and follow redirects.

components.name: API Gateway
components.description: Single entry point for create and redirect traffic.

components.name: Shortener Service
components.description: Creates short codes and resolves them to target URLs.

components.name: Link Database
components.description: Durable store of short code to target URL mappings.

components.name: Redirect Cache
components.description: Hot redirect mappings. Its connection is intentionally omitted so the graph validator reports a disconnected component.

groups.name: Backend Tier
groups.description: Everything that runs behind the public edge.

assumptions.text: Short links never expire and there is no deletion workflow in v1.
assumptions.rationale: The prompt does not state a retention or expiry policy.
